lines.text: John heard in prison about Christ's works and sent his disciples to ask if Jesus was the One to come.
Jesus told John's disciples to report that the blind receive sight, the lame walk, and the dead are raised.
Jesus asked the crowds what they went into the wilderness to see, and said fine clothing is in temple courts.
Jesus said John is more than a prophet and is the Isaiah who was to come.
Jesus compared them to children in marketplaces who called John demon-possessed and the Son of Man a glutton and drunkard.
